treatment_summary: The plan adds guideline‑directed dual antiplatelet therapy (ticagrelor 12 months) and acute angina relief (sublingual GTN), intensifies lipid lowering (maintain rosuvastatin 20 mg until liver tests improve), introduces SGLT2‑inhibitor dapagliflozin for renal‑cardioprotection, and adds amlodipine to achieve BP <130/80 mmHg. Spironolactone is pending potassium and renal checks. All existing cardioprotective drugs are continued. Interactions and contraindications have been reviewed, and monitoring intervals are defined per NICE CG126, NG106, and NG136.
